OpenContextHub · Standards interoperability

They standardize where context lives; Baltor governs whether it's true.
Adopt open formats at the EDGES (ingest + emit) and govern ABOVE them. Every adopted standard is a projection; the governed object stays the core. We add the assurance the formats themselves don't carry — verification, freshness/CDC, earned source-authority, portable receipts. Proprietary data-gravity layers are declined, not adopted.
